answer: Correlated action surcharge. Agents prepay action credits; when two identities hit one target in a window, each pays a surcharge that doubles per matching peer. A sparrow’s solo call costs 1 credit; a 50-identity cluster pays 50 each as matches accumulate. A raven can split targets, but cross-target timing links still trigger the rule. Onyx auditors sample timing and resource fingerprints to set the surcharge. Per identity: 25-credit reserve, forfeited on detection.
